meta.note: MOCK DATA for frontend development. All companies and people are fictional. estimatedHours = effort a traditional IT-services vendor would bill for the same change.

applications.name: Payments Gateway
applications.description: Card and UPI payments switch for retail banking.

applications.name: Internet Banking
applications.description: Customer-facing internet banking web app and API.

applications.name: Loan Origination
applications.description: Retail loan application, scoring and disbursal.

applications.name: KYC Service
applications.description: Customer onboarding identity and document checks.

applications.name: Agent App API
applications.description: Backend for the field-agent mobile app.

tasks.title: Add consent audit fields to KYC export
tasks.summary: Adds who-approved and when to the nightly KYC export so auditors can trace every consent change. No customer-facing change.

tasks.title: Patch OpenSSL CVE-2026-1182 in base image
tasks.summary: Updates the container base image to a patched OpenSSL so the payments switch is no longer exposed to the reported TLS flaw.

tasks.title: Patch OpenSSL CVE-2026-1182 in web image
tasks.summary: Same OpenSSL fix as the payments switch, applied to the internet banking front-end image.

tasks.title: Add document-expiry check to KYC upload
tasks.summary: Rejects identity documents that have already expired, with a clear message to the customer, instead of failing later in review.

tasks.title: Add idempotency keys to refund API
tasks.summary: Stops duplicate refunds when the same request is retried by a merchant system. Existing refunds are unaffected.

tasks.title: Add API tests for fraud rule evaluation
tasks.summary: Adds automated tests around the fraud scoring endpoint so future rule changes are caught before release.

tasks.title: Upgrade policy admin from .NET 6 to .NET 8
tasks.summary: .NET 6 is out of support. This moves the service to .NET 8 (supported until 2026+) with no change to behaviour.
tasks.escalationReason: Verification failed twice: 3 integration tests depend on a removed .NET 6 API (BinaryFormatter).

tasks.title: Fix timeout on payment confirmation page
tasks.summary: Customers on slow networks saw a timeout after paying. The page now waits for the bank's reply and shows progress.

tasks.title: Upgrade claims portal API to .NET 8
tasks.summary: Moves the claims API off unsupported .NET 6. Verified that claim submission and tracking behave exactly as before.

tasks.title: Fix session expiry redirect loop
tasks.summary: Users whose session expired mid-application were bounced between two pages. They now land on sign-in and resume where they left off.

tasks.title: Add retry to settlement webhook
tasks.summary: When the settlement partner is briefly unavailable we now retry with back-off instead of dropping the notification.

tasks.title: Patch prototype-pollution CVE in lodash
tasks.summary: Upgrades lodash to a version without the reported prototype-pollution flaw. No functional change.

tasks.title: Upgrade loan origination to .NET 8
tasks.summary: Moves loan origination off unsupported .NET 6, keeping all scoring rules identical.

tasks.title: Raise test coverage on payouts module
tasks.summary: Adds tests for payout scheduling edge cases (holidays, cut-off times). Coverage on the module goes from 38% to 71%.

tasks.title: Upgrade Spring Boot 2.7 to 3.3
tasks.summary: Spring Boot 2.7 is end of life. Upgrade to 3.3 with Java 21; all endpoints and reports behave the same.

tasks.title: Add retry to statement-generation job
tasks.summary: The monthly statement job now retries failed accounts instead of skipping them.

tasks.title: Add API tests for KYC document upload
tasks.summary: Adds automated tests for every document type and size limit on the KYC upload API.

tasks.title: Upgrade claims portal web to Node 22
tasks.summary: Node 18 is out of support. Moves the claims web app build and runtime to Node 22 LTS.

tasks.title: Patch OpenSSL CVE-2026-1182 in policy admin
tasks.summary: Updates the base image so policy admin is no longer exposed to the reported TLS flaw.

tasks.title: Fix rounding error in EMI calculator
tasks.summary: EMI amounts could be off by one paisa on some tenures. Calculation now rounds exactly as the loan agreement states.

tasks.title: Fix duplicate OTP on KYC resend
tasks.summary: Customers sometimes received two OTPs when tapping resend. Now only one is sent per 30 seconds.

tasks.title: Upgrade KYC service to Spring Boot 3.3
tasks.summary: Spring Boot 2.7 is end of life; upgrade attempted but blocked on an internal library that is not Jakarta-compatible.
tasks.escalationReason: Blocked: internal library acme-commons is not Jakarta EE compatible. Needs client decision.

tasks.title: Patch CVE in lodash (payments admin UI)
tasks.summary: Upgrades lodash in the admin UI. Client asked to keep an old endpoint, so this change was sent back.

tasks.title: Bump Jackson to 2.18
tasks.summary: Keeps the JSON library current and picks up two security fixes. No behaviour change.

tasks.title: Patch CVE in System.Text.Json
tasks.summary: Upgrades System.Text.Json to fix a denial-of-service flaw on very deep JSON input.

tasks.title: Add retry to payout webhook
tasks.summary: Payout notifications to merchants are now retried with back-off when the merchant endpoint is briefly down.
